findings.title: Managed Compute
findings.description: All compute runs on Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3 on Solaris 10. No managed container orchestration (ECS/EKS), no serverless (Lambda), no Fargate.
findings.gap: No managed compute. Entire application runs on unsupported proprietary application server on EOL operating system.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed compute — containerize on ECS/Fargate or rewrite as Lambda functions behind API Gateway.

findings.title: Managed Databases
findings.description: Database is self-managed Oracle 11g (EOL) accessed via direct JDBC. No managed database services (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB).
findings.gap: Fully self-managed database on EOL engine with no automated failover, no managed backups, no scaling.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL or Aurora PostgreSQL using AWS DMS.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration
findings.description: No workflow orchestration service. Loan submission flow hardcoded in LoanAction.execute().
findings.gap: All workflow logic hardcoded in application code with no dedicated orchestration service.
findings.recommendation: Implement AWS Step Functions for loan submission workflow with retry logic and error handling.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. All operations synchronous. For a stateful-crud archetype, state changes should propagate via async messaging.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes could benefit from async notification to downstream systems.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon SQS or EventBridge for loan application events.

findings.title: Network Security
findings.description: No VPC, no security groups, no network segmentation. Application deployed on Solaris host with no cloud networking.
findings.gap: No cloud network security infrastructure. No isolation, no segmentation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in VPC with private subnets, least-privilege security groups, and VPC endpoints.

findings.title: API Entry Point
findings.description: No API Gateway, no ALB, no CloudFront. Application exposed directly through WebLogic HTTP listener.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Implement Amazon API Gateway or ALB as entry point with throttling and auth.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Single Solaris host with static capacity.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned. No elasticity.
findings.recommendation: Configure auto-scaling with target tracking policies when migrating to ECS/Fargate.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery
findings.description: No backup configuration found. No backup plans, no retention periods, no PITR.
findings.gap: No backup configuration. No defined retention, no tested restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Enable automated backups with 7+ day retention and PITR when migrating to RDS/Aurora.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
findings.description: Zero IaC. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or Helm charts. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage. All infrastructure created manually.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in AWS CDK or Terraform — compute, networking, database.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual WAR upload via WebLogic admin console. Build via Apache Ant with committed jars.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments manual. No automated build, test, or deploy.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated build, test, deploy, and rollback stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages
findings.description: Java 5 with Apache Struts 1.3 (EOL since 2013). Compound legacy: ancient language version, defunct framework, no AWS SDK.
findings.gap: Language version (Java 5), framework (Struts 1.3), and SDK (none) all severely regressed.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Java 17+ with Spring Boot 3.x and AWS SDK v2.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith. Single Action class handles all logic, data access, and flow control. Hardcoded credentials, direct JDBC, no abstraction.
findings.gap: Pervasive coupling — presentation, business logic, and data access all in one class. No separation of concerns.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with Hexagonal Architecture. Separate loan pricing, submission, and persistence into bounded contexts.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication
findings.description: All communication synchronous HTTP. Struts Action does synchronous DB INSERT and returns JSP forward. No async patterns.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no capability to decouple loan submission from downstream processing.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async patterns — publish loan-submitted event to SQS/EventBridge for downstream consumers.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling
findings.description: All operations synchronous with no infrastructure for async job processing. No background job framework, no status polling.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No async job infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for operations exceeding 30s using SQS + Lambda or Step Functions.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. Struts action mapping uses /loan with no version prefix.
findings.gap: No versioning — changes would break all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL path versioning (e.g., /v1/loans) with backward compatibility guarantees.

findings.title: Service Discovery
findings.description: Database endpoint hardcoded in source code. No service discovery, no environment variables for endpoints.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded in application code as compile-time constants.
findings.recommendation: Externalize endpoints to environment variables or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage
findings.description: No managed object storage. No S3 buckets, no document parsing pipeline. Loan data stored in Oracle only.
findings.gap: No managed object storage for unstructured data.
findings.recommendation: Implement S3 for document storage with Amazon Textract for loan document parsing.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer
findings.description: Database queries directly embedded in Action class via raw JDBC with string-concatenated SQL. SQL injection vulnerability present.
findings.gap: Database imports and queries scattered with no pattern. Direct JDBC with string concatenation.
findings.recommendation: Implement repository/DAO layer with Spring Data JPA and parameterized queries.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
findings.description: Oracle 11g is well past end-of-life. No version pinning in IaC (no IaC exists). Security patches unavailable.
findings.gap: Database engine at EOL with no version management or update procedure.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Aurora PostgreSQL or RDS PostgreSQL using AWS SCT and DMS.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Oracle 11g has no KMS integration. Sensitive loan data stored without encryption.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for any data store.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS keys when migrating to RDS/Aurora.

findings.title: API Authentication
findings.description: Container-managed auth (WebLogic) via request.getRemoteUser(). No OAuth2/JWT token-based authentication.
findings.gap: No token-based authentication. Auth is container-managed with static credentials.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT via Amazon Cognito with Bearer token validation.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration
findings.description: No centralized IdP integration. Authentication managed entirely by WebLogic container with no external IdP.
findings.gap: Application manages own authentication with no external IdP integration or SSO.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or external IdP for centralized auth with SSO.

findings.title: Secrets Management
findings.description: CRITICAL: Database credentials hardcoded in source code — DB_PASS = 'loanApp2010' visible in LoanAction.java. Password committed to version control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source code. Password exposed in VCS history.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate exposed credential. Migrate all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching
findings.description: No patching strategy. Solaris 10, WebLogic 10.3, Java 5 — all EOL. No vulnerability scanning. Jars committed without version manifest.
findings.gap: No patching, no vulnerability scanning. All runtime components past EOL.
findings.recommendation: Use hardened container images, implement vulnerability scanning, add Dependabot for dependencies.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate into. SQL injection vulnerability undetected in codebase.
findings.gap: No SAST, no DAST, no dependency scanning. Known SQL injection exists.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST (SonarQube, Semgrep) and dependency scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no trace propagation.
findings.gap: No tracing instrumented. No ability to trace requests or diagnose issues.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry when migrating to modern stack.

findings.title: SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No CloudWatch alarms, no latency targets, no error budget tracking.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for loan quote response time and submission success rate.

findings.title: Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics. No business outcome tracking (loan submissions, approval rates).
findings.gap: No custom metrics — no visibility into business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch metrics for loans quoted, submitted, average principal.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection.
findings.gap: No alerting. Failures detected only when users report them.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch anomaly detection on error rates and latency.

findings.title: Integration Testing
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. README states: 'No unit tests; testing is a shared UAT environment.'
findings.gap: No tests whatsoever. Extreme regression risk during any modification.
findings.recommendation: Implement unit tests (JUnit 5), integration tests, and API tests. Run in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Observability Ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership. No dashboards, no alarms with named owners, no CODEOWNERS.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: Define observability ownership. Assign dashboard and alarm ownership.
